scope: Source relevance, provenance, counting, verification-status honesty, URL normalization, extraction quality and workspace publication privacy.
count_semantics: Distinct source documents after URL/content-hash deduplication, not independent experiments or manually reviewed papers. Original source page retrieval may be a README, model card, dataset card, or abstract landing page, not full paper text.

sample.design: Purposive selection of 10 direct papers and 10 model cards; seeded stratified selection of 15 application repositories, 10 dataset cards and 15 contextual abstracts. This is a targeted quality audit, not a statistical estimate of corpus precision.

provenance.path: Decision Index news/model/methodology sources -> linked ecosystem index or artifact -> actual public README/card/page. Aggregator descriptions alone do not qualify a child source as content_screened.

findings.finding: 3352 checked sources comprise 1929 original-page content/editorial records and 1423 abstract-only records. 48 metadata-only records are excluded. The 60 selected reviews do not upgrade the entire corpus to editorial_reviewed.

Dropping all query parameters incorrectly merged four CiteSeer records and two OpenReview records and broke their links. The builder now preserves document identifiers, leaving 8 genuine duplicates rather than 12.
Fourteen obvious title extractions selected generic headings or code comments. Browser projection falls back to repository/dataset identifiers; raw ledgers preserve extraction provenance.
Three sampled dataset records are result archives, not training datasets. They remain relevant but the raw training-dataset topic is too broad.
The Twitter financial sentiment card reports a total different from the sum of its listed splits; inclusion verifies source relevance, not numerical consistency.
Tev1 explicitly retains a standard next-token head and returns generated option letters. Jev-inspired implementations must not all be described as non-autoregressive.
Two DOI fetches failed and one publisher page exposed only an application template. Their original abstracts were re-read via OpenAlex and remain abstract-only records.
The background sample includes edge-NPU scheduling and personalized federated learning. These are broad context, not direct Jev studies; the core list should remain more selective.
Model cards and project READMEs contain calibration, hallucination, safety and performance claims. This audit confirms content and relevance, not those claims or installation safety.

privacy.scope: Repository scripts, ledgers, documentation, website and workflow files; no scan outside the shared project.
privacy.credential_use: Public unauthenticated source requests only; no inference API keys supplied.
privacy.checks: Searches for literal personal filesystem paths, common access-token forms and private-key markers. One path-pattern match in scripts/validate.py is the scanner's own regex, not a user path.
privacy.limitation: Pattern scanning is not a formal security guarantee; linked external apps can have their own data transmission behavior.

selected_records.title: [2609.23886] this-that-model-1.0: A typed decision model that decides in 30 ms, for a millionth of a cent
selected_records.editorial_note: Direct open typed-decision model paper. Abstract describes hidden-state readout and a small external comparison; performance claims remain author-reported.

selected_records.title: [2609.23986] Jev-Mem: System-One-Controlled Agentic Memory for Efficient AI Agents
selected_records.editorial_note: Direct Jev memory-control paper. Its reported outcome is an agentic-memory workflow score, not standalone decision accuracy.

selected_records.title: [2609.29283] From Text Decisions to Pixels: An Study of Jev-Style Visual Choice Model
selected_records.editorial_note: Direct visual decision model paper. Abstract distinguishes adaptation gains from candidate-readout validity and notes calibration limits.

selected_records.title: [2609.31142] JevAdvBench: A Benchmark and Black-Box Attacks for Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions Models
selected_records.editorial_note: Direct Jev adversarial benchmark. Measures changes relative to clean and repeated calls; changed decisions are not automatically incorrect decisions.

selected_records.title: [2609.33209] Beyond Calibration: Do a Typed-Decision Model's Probabilities Obey the Probability Axioms?
selected_records.editorial_note: Direct probability-coherence study. Logically related question probabilities are tested separately from marginal accuracy and calibration.

selected_records.title: [2609.33401] Evaluating System One Models for Agent Security Decisions: Reliability, Calibration, and Selective Automation
selected_records.editorial_note: Direct security evaluation. Abstract distinguishes group-specific confident errors and allowed versus blocked automation.

selected_records.title: [2609.35342] Jev thinks "I don't know'', but doesn't say it: Introducing Sys1Cal-v1 Dataset for Probability Calibration
selected_records.editorial_note: Direct probability-calibration dataset study. Known constructed probabilities support a controlled test; latent unknown-state interpretation is an author hypothesis.

selected_records.title: [2609.36965] Chinese-Jev: Bringing System One Model to Chinese-Language Tasks
selected_records.editorial_note: Direct Chinese typed-decision model paper. Domain-specific training and the proposed Chinese benchmark require separate validation.

selected_records.title: [2610.18773] Jeva: System One Models from First Principles
selected_records.editorial_note: Direct decision-model architecture paper. Null handling, permutation behavior, option scaling and caching are design claims about Jeva, not revealed Jev internals.

selected_records.title: [2610.21244] System1-Arena: Which Decisions Can Be Left to System 1?
selected_records.editorial_note: Direct decision benchmark paper published on the snapshot date. Covers matched requests and closed-loop tasks; experiments were not reproduced.

selected_records.title: Clef
selected_records.editorial_note: Model card describes a multimodal backbone and joint schema head, with Jev API compatibility. Compatibility does not establish identical internals.

selected_records.title: DM-JEPA 1.1: Decision-Making Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture
selected_records.editorial_note: Model card describes a latent decision architecture. Speed, calibration and hallucination wording are creator claims, not this audit's findings.

selected_records.title: Laya
selected_records.editorial_note: Model card describes multilingual typed decisions and RLCD. Claims of mathematical calibration are not accepted as empirical guarantees.

selected_records.title: pplx-decider-v1.1-27b
selected_records.editorial_note: Model card documents noncausal full attention and a calibrated decision head. Its older self-reported leaderboard scores must retain their edition context.

selected_records.title: Intern-Decision-4B
selected_records.editorial_note: Model card documents one-forward-pass candidate-symbol probabilities and masked placeholders; concrete inference instructions support direct relevance.

selected_records.title: Kev-4B
selected_records.editorial_note: Model card documents a LoRA adapter and pointer head with a compatible endpoint. This is an independent model artifact.

selected_records.title: Tev1-4B-experimental
selected_records.editorial_note: Model card explicitly says supervised fine-tuning with the ordinary next-token head and generated option letters; do not label all Jev-inspired models non-autoregressive.

selected_records.title: d3
selected_records.editorial_note: Model card describes multimodal typed decisions and public/private score components. Its ranking statements are model-publisher claims.

selected_records.title: Shisa DE-2
selected_records.editorial_note: Model card describes restricted next-token probabilities and shuffled option training; a typed interface does not imply a wholly new backbone.

selected_records.title: tasksource-decider-nano
selected_records.editorial_note: Model card describes a compact joint cross-encoder, shared state and a decision head. Renamed repositories and version tags matter for deduplication.

selected_records.title: skill-router
selected_records.editorial_note: README explicitly uses Jev Noul questions to suggest coding skills, making direct ecosystem relevance clear.

selected_records.title: jev-code
selected_records.editorial_note: README documents Jev decision tools for coding agents. Availability and claims were read; code and integrations were not executed.

selected_records.title: ask-jev
selected_records.editorial_note: README explicitly describes sending selected conversation content to TypeSafe. Included as an integration example, not certified as private.

selected_records.title: hunch
selected_records.editorial_note: README describes a browser playground that calls OpenRouter with the user's key. This audit did not enter a key or execute the app.

selected_records.title: Decision-Native Agent Runtime
selected_records.editorial_note: README describes bounded decisions and an explicit approval boundary. Its deterministic smoke test is correctly distinguished from model quality.

selected_records.title: Jevstral
selected_records.editorial_note: README explicitly disclaims TypeSafe affiliation and describes independent model weights and typed decisions.

selected_records.title: jev-vs-pii
selected_records.editorial_note: README evaluates personal-information masking with task-specific prompts. Its accuracy and timing claims were not reproduced.

selected_records.title: JevX
selected_records.editorial_note: README describes finding and replacing code rules with Jev calls. We did not run the software or validate its safety claims.

selected_records.title: IntelliPrompter
selected_records.editorial_note: README shows talking-point coverage as parallel Jev Score questions. Cost comparisons are developer claims.

selected_records.title: SemDecide
selected_records.editorial_note: README documents typed predicates and routing for Unix pipelines. Clear direct use case; no installation performed.

selected_records.title: nf-jev
selected_records.editorial_note: README documents Nextflow primitives and beta status. Strong general claims about model confidence should not be copied unqualified.

selected_records.title: jev-asks-until-sure
selected_records.editorial_note: README describes a game driven by confidence thresholds and abstention. Product behavior is an application example, not calibration evidence.

selected_records.title: TypeSafe Conversation for Home Assistant
selected_records.editorial_note: README describes Home Assistant decisions with an LLM fallback. Device control and data handling were not security-audited.

selected_records.title: Sudoku vs Jev
selected_records.editorial_note: README describes a Sudoku decision loop with code-owned rules and benchmark scripts. Relevant testbed, with no benchmark execution here.

selected_records.title: dsh-jev-verify
selected_records.editorial_note: README describes a Jev plugin with risk checks and usage reports. Universal confidence wording should be checked against current Noul documentation.

selected_records.title: Lavoir Dialogues
selected_records.editorial_note: Dataset card describes synthetic customer-service dialogues and exact routing posteriors; useful for decision and clarification-policy training.

selected_records.title: tasksource-jev-typed-decisions
selected_records.editorial_note: Dataset card describes source-annotation transformations into typed decisions and explicitly retains annotation noise.

selected_records.title: Dataset Card for CLINC150
selected_records.editorial_note: Dataset card describes intent classification and out-of-scope examples. Adjacent benchmark material, not Jev-specific evidence.

selected_records.title: Sieve-9B: Decision Index results
selected_records.editorial_note: Card describes Sieve-9B evaluation result files, not training examples. Retain as a results archive and correct the training-dataset topic.

selected_records.title: Open-Jev: typed decision datasets
selected_records.editorial_note: Card explicitly distinguishes independent synthetic decision datasets from official TypeSafe training data.

selected_records.title: Sieve-27B: Decision Index results
selected_records.editorial_note: Card describes Sieve-27B evaluation runs and versioned manifests. It is a results archive, not a training dataset.

selected_records.title: Data Splits
selected_records.editorial_note: Card is relevant sentiment data but states 11,932 documents while its split table sums to 12,424. Do not reuse its counts without investigation.

selected_records.title: Dataset Card for GoEmotions
selected_records.editorial_note: Card describes English multi-label emotion annotations. Relevant upstream data; neither Jev performance nor calibration follows from inclusion.

selected_records.title: HelpSteer2: Open-source dataset for training top-performing reward models
selected_records.editorial_note: Card describes helpfulness annotations and reward-model training. Published benchmark claims refer to other models and dates.

selected_records.title: Decision Index runs
selected_records.editorial_note: Card contains crivo evaluation result manifests and deliberately omits benchmark payloads. Topic should be evaluation-results archive.
